title: पूरी पुड़िया
governed_by: content/series1/episodes/s1e01/script.hi.json and script.en.json (revision 2; same beats, lines and speakers)
content/series1/style.json (locks rewritten after Gate 3, style_frame, light_states, prompt_assembly)
runner: production/scripts/codex-frame.sh <frames_dir> <shot_id> <frames/prompts/<shot_id>.txt> [refs in the order listed in the shot]. Only shots with frame.kind = generated are sent to the runner.

frame_budget.note: 28 new frames for 36 shots (the D-010 budget, now fully spent: s05 became a generated MCU under D-023 rule 4.8). Second framings reuse an approved frame of this episode with a custom camera move at scale 1.3 or less (D-010). s31 is the one approved photograph (refs/photograph.png, D-007 direction 15), never regenerated. Retakes (s02, s03, s20, s21, attempt 2 each) are retakes, not new frames.

estimated_seconds.basis: Measured duration_s of every line in voice/manifest.jsonl (latest take where a retake exists: hi l04 take 2 = 3.68 s, hi l16 take 2 = 2.40 s, en l16 take 2 = 2.48 s), plus the script's beat silences (11.2 s), plus 0.25 s after each of the 26 lines (6.5 s). Speech: hi 93.60 s, en 85.04 s. Shot durations below use the longer language shot by shot (duration_s); duration_hi_s and duration_en_s are what each cut gets if its timeline is rebuilt from its own clips (D-014 rule 6). Where one line is split across two shots, the split point is the measured sentence pause and the two parts are estimates; the editor cuts on the pause that silencedetect finds.
estimated_seconds.clarity_remap_D025: 2026-11-26, S7 Storyboard artist, clarity remap (D-025 item 8): totals re-summed from the shots after the remap. Shots that gained lines or changed split are timed from the clarity takes (voice/manifest.jsonl, highest ok take per line): whole clip length + 0.25 s after each line, plus the beat silence the shot carries; split parts at the midpoint of the measured pause (silencedetect -40 dB, 0.15 s). Other voiced shots are shifted by (clarity take - previous take) for each re-voiced line. Planned only: the build times voiced shots from speech.

longest_setup.rule: No set-up held past 8 s (bible production_locks, D-018 storyboards note on measured lengths). Every shot is under 8 s in both languages.

scenes.anchor_reason: First frame of the scene that shows the lead's face (D-013 rule 2): Kiran as 'Sneha' at the stool, with the tray, the tumbler and the open fold, the window grille and both light sources. It is generated first in this scene and is the only bedroom frame that carries the style frame. b6 to b11 follow the lane cutaway inside the same continuous minute, so they are the same scene and attach the same anchor; their prompts list what has changed since s04 under 'do not copy from the anchor'.
scenes.style_frame_on: s04 only (bedroom_bed.png, attached last; the plate of s04 is bedroom_window, a different file, so both are attached)

scenes.anchor_reason: The only person in the scene is Billu; s15 is his face, the car and the lane light. Generated first in the scene with the style frame; s14 attaches it as anchor; s16 is a second framing of s14.
scenes.style_frame_on: s15 only (bedroom_bed.png, attached last, labelled rendering-only)

generation_gates: D-015 rule 7: generate the two anchors (s04, s15), run the anchor check, and only then the other 25. Every other bedroom frame attaches frames/s04.png and s14 attaches frames/s15.png, so they cannot run before their anchor is approved.

D-021 decision 6 retake check: it must finish before any frame that attaches a sheet it names. Neither anchor does (s04: kiran_p1, bedroom_window, glass_and_fold, style frame; s15: billu, billu_car, style frame). Two later frames do: s20 attaches pair_kiran_aditya_p1 (backs of Kiran's hands) and s14 attaches lane_night (boot-lid mark). Hold those two until the check has reported.

D-017 watch item: s20 is the first Kiran-Aditya two-shot. He is seated and she is standing a room's width away, so it is not a same-depth height test; the line-up sheet is attached for faces and scale only.
screen_direction: Bedroom geography (style.json): facing the headboard from the door, the window is in the right wall, the almirah, chair and maroon bag against the left wall, the lamp on the almirah side of the headboard, the stool and tray on the window side of the bed.

From b3 on the line runs from Kiran at the door to Aditya on the foot edge of the bed. Every camera stays on the almirah side of that line. So Kiran's singles (s07, s17, s21, s27, s33; plate bedroom_door) have the window on picture-left and the lamp light from picture-right, and she looks just past the picture-left edge of the lens. Aditya's singles (s03, s05, s18, s19, s23, s26, s28, s32; plate bedroom_bed) have the lamp at picture-left and the window at picture-right, and he looks just past the picture-right edge of the lens. The two-shot s20 (plate bedroom_window, from beside the almirah) puts him at picture-left facing right and her at picture-right facing left.
In b1 and b2 Kiran is at the stool on the window side; s04 (plate bedroom_window) has the bed on picture-left and her looking towards picture-left, which matches the later convention.

Lane: s14 follows the lane_night plate (car picture-left, house and lit window picture-right). s15 is outside the open driver's window with the house behind the camera; Billu looks up just above the top of the lens.

This ledger is built from its s1e01 end_state, the wardrobe_changes for kiran and aditya, problems P02 and P07, style.json key_props and characters.*.continuity_notes, and the script's action lines. Sides are the character's own; every prompt converts them to picture terms (D-013 rule 3).

field_notes.duration_s: Longer language, this shot (max of duration_hi_s and duration_en_s).
field_notes.silent_lead_s: Seconds of the shot before its first line starts (the script's beat silence 'before').
field_notes.camera_move: Maps to Move in production/remotion/src/types.ts. For 'custom', from/to are CameraKey {scale, x, y}: x positive looks further left, y positive looks further up (camera.ts). Every second framing keeps scale at or under 1.3 (D-010).
field_notes.refs: Absolute paths, at most five, in the order the prompt labels them: people (pair or single sheet, hand sheet), plate, prop sheets, then scene anchor or, on an anchor, the style frame (D-013 rule 1, D-017 amendment 3, D-021 decision 3).
field_notes.subtitle_safe: true = faces, hands that matter and the key object are above the bottom fifth of the frame.

storyboard_notes: 36 shots for 10 beats. Every script set-up and insert is a shot, in script order; nothing is merged and nothing is added.
Second framings (8): s05 of s03, s16 of s14, s19 of s18, s22 of s08, s24 of s17, s25 of s21, s26 of s28, s34 of s30. Each is a custom move between scales 1.1 and 1.3 on the source frame.

Departures from the script's set-up wording, all to stay inside 28 frames: (1) s16 (l10) was 'low angle from beside the car up to the lit window'; it is a 1.15 to 1.3 push on the lit window of the s14 wide instead, so the marigold string on the grille is written into s14. (2) s34 (l26) reuses s30; the print is held out beside his face, not raised close to it. (3) s25 (l19) reuses s21, so her chin is level-to-raised as in s21. (4) s22 (l16) reuses the s08 padlock insert, as the script's 'again' allows. If any of these reads wrong in the cut, the one unspent frame goes to it.

Lane light: the script says 'sodium streetlight'; style.json makes the lane's one streetlight cool blue-white (art_director_notes) so the bedroom rim is motivated. The prompts follow style.json and light_states.lane_night.
The lane_night plate holds an old motorbike behind the car. s1e01 says nobody else is in the lane and the boys are not in this episode; the bike stays as an empty parked bike, as the plate shows it.
Readable text is overlay only: '1:40' on s14 (a plain dark area is left at upper picture-left) and 'No network' on the s12 phone screen (the screen is a plain dim glow).
Mausi is voice only (l09, l10 over the lane). Mohit is only the hand in the photograph. No ceiling fan anywhere. Never more than two faces in a frame (s20 is the only two-face frame).

Lines on faces: stills cannot lip-sync, so most lines play over the listener or an insert. Lines on the speaker's own face: l03 part 1 (s05), l12, l13, l17, l22, l25 and l24 (Aditya), l11, l15, l19 (Kiran). Each of those frames is written with the mouth closed or barely parted.

The b9 photograph insert (s31) is refs/photograph.png, a studio-lit prop reference of the one approved print (style.json key_props.photograph: 'cropped or re-framed, never regenerated'). If the grey surface still shows round the print at scale 1.3, the editor shows it as a print lying on grey; it is not regenerated.

s35 and s36 attach refs/photograph.png for composition only, so that her forearm crosses the frame at the same angle and the crescent sits at the same place and scale as in s31 (review-notes cliffhanger_mirror).

P07 (fold set down) is carried by the STATE of s04 and s06: the fold lies open on the tray from b2. P02 (right cuff) is left as continuity.json says: the right cuff is still pushed up at the end of s1e01; s1e02 b1 brings it down.

26 Nov, D-023 retake run (S7 with a shell): s02, s03, s20, s21 retaken once each; s21 and s02 restaged under rule 4.6 (cuff framed out, kiran_hands dropped); s05 changed from a second framing of s03 to a generated MCU (rule 4.8, the 28th frame); s25 re-aimed at her face. s03's pocket is still on the wrong side after its retake and is accepted and logged (D-013 rule 11). edit.json moves for s05 and s25 are now stale; that is the editor's file.
